---
name: Epic
about: Coordinate related work toward a larger outcome.
type: Epic
---

<!-- Describe the larger outcome clearly enough to guide work across its child
issues. Keep implementation detail in those issues or linked design documents. -->

## Outcome and context
<!-- What should this work achieve, for whom, and why? Explain the current
situation and summarise decisions or evidence that shape the intended outcome. -->

## Scope and boundaries
<!-- What is included, what is explicitly outside this effort, and which agreed
constraints apply? Link work owned elsewhere. Separate agreed scope from ideas
that still need a decision. -->

## Work breakdown
<!-- Link known child issues and explain their contribution or sequence where
useful. Identify cross-repository work. Mark candidate follow-ups as tentative;
a complete implementation plan is not required upfront. -->

## Success criteria
<!-- What observable outcomes complete the epic? Closing child issues alone is
not sufficient if the overall outcome has not been achieved. Keep detailed
acceptance criteria in the child issues rather than repeating them here. -->
- [ ]

## Owner and dependencies
<!-- Who coordinates the outcome? If undecided, say so. Link blocking dependencies
and identify open decisions, distinguishing them from supporting references. -->
